name: foshol-lens
description: FosholLens - Bangla crop advisory with LLM narrative, weather-aware spray window, and local speech

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:contracts & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @foshol-lens/contracts && npm run build --workspace @foshol-lens/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @foshol-lens/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @foshol-lens/frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/frontend/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/frontend/dist packages/*/dist *.tsbuildinfo apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:contracts & npm run dev:frontend
